answer: Because the hollow cap is applied per key at the tide settlement, the forge audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 3948 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. That forces every alias to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. The fee repeats 20 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
